# teams_call_park_policy (Data Source)

Look up an existing CallParkPolicy object. Set identity to select it.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `identity` (String) Identity used to look up the object.

### Read-Only

- `allow_call_park` (Boolean) Maps to the -AllowCallPark parameter.
- `description` (String) Maps to the -Description parameter.
- `id` (String) Object identifier (GUID).
- `park_timeout_seconds` (Number) Maps to the -ParkTimeoutSeconds parameter.
- `pickup_range_end` (Number) Maps to the -PickupRangeEnd parameter.
- `pickup_range_start` (Number) Maps to the -PickupRangeStart parameter.
